trap.label: been vs gone
trap.wrong: She has gone to Paris twice. (já voltou)
trap.right: She has been to Paris twice.
trap.why: Em português 'foi' cobre os dois casos; em inglês been = foi e voltou, gone = foi e ainda está lá.

mcq.q: He's ___ to London. He's not here now.

fix.wrong: Have you ever went to Peru?
fix.right: Have you ever been to Peru?

fix.wrong: She has gone to the dentist twice, and she is fine.
fix.right: She has been to the dentist twice, and she is fine.

rewrite.prompt: Troque por been: “I went to Rome and came back.” (experiência)
Negativa com yet: “I have read it.”
Pergunta: “They have been to Brazil.” com ever
rewrite.answer: Have they ever been to Brazil?
